[[Eshekibeh's Scythe]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Marobeh Sharptail]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Vehjin Mines]].


==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Duskblade Scythe]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Scythe]]s:
**[[Briarwood Scythe]] from collectors [[Vixx]] or [[Qogg]]
**[[Elegant Scythe]] from collectors [[Swift Fiercejustice]] or [[Jovial Pete]]
**[[Hooked Scythe]] from collectors [[Kapunk]] or [[Rapk]]
**[[Suntouched Scythe]] from collectors [[Tohsedi]] or [[Seung]] or crafters [[Grif Ebonmane]], [[Kehjim]], or [[Wisseh]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Vampiric]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[Scythe]]s:
**[[Suntouched Scythe]] from collectors [[Hlengiwe]] or [[Hermehinu]] or crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scythe]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Scythe]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scythe]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Envoy Scythe]] from crafter [[Jessie Llam]]
**[[Norn Scythe]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scythe]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Scythe]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Scythe of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Charr Scythe]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scythe]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scythe]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scythe]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Vampiric]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Guided by Fate]]" inscription

==Notes==  
Its possible that this item (or its [[boss]]) were accidentally mislabeled.  [[Marobeh Sharptail]] drops this item, while [[Eshekibeh Longneck]], a [[Necromancer]] boss, drops [[Marobeh's Chill]].
